Chapter 6223: So I Am At The Bottom

Chapter 6223: So I Am At The Bottom

"Lankavatara Scripture!" Bamboo Venerable couldn't help being astounded once more: "You are a disciple of Lankavatara Temple?" [1]

"Amitabha." Monk Zhu continued pushing his bowl onto the next layer of the barrier. Alas, it didn't go well.

"I thought you were a novice monk from a small temple." Orchidcore said.

"Lankavatara is a small temple." Black Witch Monarch remarked.

Monk Zhu's true background surprised his friends just like Princess Chen's.

Amidst the rumination, Mu Hu made his move with a wooden saber.

It seemed silly but when he raised the blade, its gleam illuminated all directions and made others shudder. Courage shattered before its might.

"Desolate Slaughter!" He roared.

"What?!" Bamboo Venerable's barrier layers were cut down instantly.

Fortunately, he reacted quickly and summoned his lotus dao, preventing anything from getting through. His cultivation successfully stopped the immaculate slash.

Mu Hu turned pale since the slash took everything he had.

"Desolate Saber Art!" The old man was frightened to see this, even more so than the princess' Heaven Suppression Fist.

"Desolate Ancestor's technique." Orchidcore and Li Xian gasped.

The other two took a deep breath.

"It's the best of the best." Black Witch Monarch couldn't help but praise.

This was the most famous out of the merit laws she left for Desolate Frontier. Others didn't have the privilege to see her in action with it, only the disciples from the faction.

"A disciple of Desolate Frontier." Bamboo Venerable stared at Mu Hu, aware that ordinary disciples didn't have access to this merit law.

"Sigh, so I was at the bottom, you guys really tricked me." Orchidcore smiled wryly.

He was the leader of the young saints since the others never revealed their true backgrounds. On the surface, he had the best background and the strongest cultivation.

"Hahaha, you juniors turn out to be hidden dragons. Unfortunately, your cultivation is still too weak." Bamboo Venerable raised his stick and summoned countless illusory versions.

"Break!" The group tried to stop the tsunami crashing down on them.

"Clank!" Black-white swords engulfed the air while the princess used her domineering punch again.

Monk Zhu's Buddhist affinity knew no bounds as the bowl formed a mighty defense. Mu Hu's strength was depleted but he still slashed again with all of his might. This made him vomit blood.

Despite their combined efforts, they still couldn't stop a desolate god.

"Bam!" The black-white swords crumbled. Monk Zhu's defense was shattered along with everything else.

They smashed against the ground, heavily injured.

"Are you okay?!" Li Xian rushed over to help them up.

All four were pale with blood streaming from their mouth.

"You should be proud of yourselves for being this strong already. But, I will not show mercy if you insist on being suicidal." The venerable uttered coldly.

"Who's being suicidal?" The monarch smiled and appeared behind him, tossing out a handful of beans.

"Rumble!" Various gods manifested into reality.

"Kill him." The monarch chanted while pointing with his wooden sword.

"Whoosh!" A giant swung his axe down with immense power.

"Green Ocean!" Bamboo Venerable reacted fast and whirled his stick, summoning a green tsunami to stop the swing.

However, a god with eight arms wielding vajras attacked like a storm. An earth god also lifted up a mountain for a merciless smash.

Although Bamboo Venerable stopped the first strike, the others struck him and sent him to the ground.

"Ugh..." He got out of the pit, seriously injured.

"Who dares harm my junior brother?!" A thunderous roar echoed.

"Clank!" The hymn of a saber sounded before sharp waves took over the battlefield.

1. Bamboo was first introduced as Willow in the official raw but the author changed a character later, so it is Bamboo. Previous chapters are updated ☜
